verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 / DGX B200 is on-premises GPU hardware with a system software stack. User data sits on the customer's own machine rather than being held by the vendor, so "export all my data in open formats and leave" is a SaaS data-portability axis that does not fit this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows NVIDIA holding user data or offering a data-export feature that would make the axis apply. The Fabric Manager not being open source (comm-3) concerns openness of the software stack, not data export, so it was not credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
